fields.statement: Hands-on at e8198352 with a scratch build (go build -o $TMPDIR/rhiza-x ./cmd/rhiza) in a fresh scratch git repo, RHIZA_* env unset: rhiza init, change new, a one-step wait workflow, run start --no-wait -> run stopped. With RHIZA_SESSION set to a real session ID, rhiza run resume <run> exits 2 with stderr 'run resume refused: this is agent session <id>, and no agent session starts a run' and next 'ask the owner to run it outside an agent session'; --json and rhiza api call run.resume return the same usage error with the ID. shasum of .git/rhiza/runs/* before and after all refused attempts is identical (journal unchanged). --dry-run inside the session still previews (as run start --dry-run does); a whitespace-only RHIZA_SESSION is not treated as a session. With RHIZA_SESSION unset the same resume continues and the run passes. run start in the session still refuses with the same wording. make check: fmt, vet and go test pass; self-check fails only on stale renders for this review run's actor records.
